description.description: What the panel shows, in one sentence.

requires.description: Commands that must be on PATH, like "gh". The tile says which are missing instead of failing.

type.description: script prints rows as JSON; cli shows the output as is.

mode.description: interval runs the command every `every`. stream keeps it running: each line a script prints is a new JSON document, and a cli panel shows the latest lines. Restarted if it exits.

command.description: Run with /bin/sh -c in this panel's folder, with your login shell's PATH.

every.description: How often to refresh an interval panel. At least 5s.

timeout.description: How long an interval panel's command may run.

size.description: Default size; config.json can override it. s 1×1, m 2×1, l 2×2, xl 2×3
